sayLines: A person, maybe 30s heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
A person, maybe 40s, with a limp walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
A woman, maybe 20s heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
A woman, maybe 40s heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin."
A man, maybe 40s heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
A man, maybe 30s heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."

📖 the woman in her 60s, with thick glasses is walking the woman in her 60s, with grey-streaked hair through an understory tree with ribbed yellow-red pods growing straight out of the trunk — leaf, stem, smell, the beginner's tour.
A woman, maybe 60s, with grey-streaked hair is working the cookpot, tasting, adjusting.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
MOLT: your skin splits. You step out new, whole — and naked. All equipped gear lost in the old skin. (Once per week.)
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND **Molt**. It resonates with: something unnamed.
